design.purpose: Same-vertical, same-page-type and same-evaluation-split reserve for the 1,000-page v3 expansion. It must never enlarge the target during composition.
design.replacementRule: A reserve page may replace only a failed primary page with the same vertical, discovered/page type and evaluation split. Login, challenge and network failures never count as no-content negatives.
design.siteRule: 160 additional registrable domains x 5 pages provide an 800-page reserve. Each of 20 verticals has eight sites, and compose uses only enough valid same-cell pages to fill primary shortfalls without enlarging the 1,000-page target.

evaluationSplit.note: Reserve inventory; replacement consumes only pages matching the failed primary split.
